payload.directive: Do not wait for ClayCode when useful work exists. Build the same current new FRANK target architecture first in ordinary executable code, research/test/refine it there, freeze semantics, then transfer those same semantics into ClayCode H2.
payload.not_requested: Do not rebuild the old frankv0.1 architecture as the new H1 target.
payload.frankv0_1_role: archaeology + regression + live-user evidence + reusable mechanisms only

parallel_lanes.frank_harness: normal-code H1 current target architecture build/test/refinement
parallel_lanes.bridge: convert validated H1 behavior into explicit ClayCode requirements and later differential H2 tests

payload.gate_rule: H1 may build during BASE; H1 PASS remains formally gated. Parallel work does not bypass release gates.
payload.worker_rule: No Frank worker should report waiting for ClayCode while non-ClayCode-dependent target-architecture H1 work remains executable.
